sn11.16:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || 2.
sn11.16:1.2: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 3.
sn11.16:1.3: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi ||
